The proof addresses the fact that TypeInvariant alone is not inductive due to the next-state expression in Do(p) accessing fields of buf[p] that are only valid when buf[p] is in MReq. To resolve this, the invariant is strengthened with BufConsistent, which ensures that buf[p] has the correct type depending on the value of ctl[p]. The proof is structured hierarchically and demonstrates that the strengthened invariant (Inv) is inductive, and thus TypeInvariant is always preserved.
